children: Bravada Gold Corporation (V.BVA) Hit a 52-Week High of $1.25. Bravada announced results from an updated Preliminary Economic Assessment for its 100%-owned Wind Mountain Gold-Silver Project located in Northern Nevada.

Covalon Technologies Ltd. (V.COV) Hit a 52-Week High of $3.07. Covalon reports Q3 revenue increased 20% year-over-year to $10 million, with all three sales channels contributing to growth. Adjusted EBITDA more than tripled to $3.0 million, reflecting efficient scaling with operating expenses up only 1%.

Cavvy Energy Limited (T.CVVY) Hit a 52-Week High of $2.20. Earlier this month, Cavvy announced its second-quarter 2026 financial and operating results. The Company produced 21,497 boe/d of hydrocarbons, 984 mt/d of sulphur, and generated Net Operating Income of $49.6 million in the second quarter of 2026.
Fidelity Minerals Corp. (V.FMN) Hit a 52-Week High of 31 cents. No news stories available.
Flow Capital Corp (C.FW) Hit a 52-Week High of 90 cents. No news stories available.

Highcliff Metals Corp. (V.HCM-H) Hit a 52-Week High of 70 cents. In early August, Highcliff successfully completed its non-brokered private placement financing. The Company appreciates the continued support of its shareholders and investors.

Hammond Manufacturing Company Ltd (T.HMM.A) Hit a 52-Week High of $24.45. In July, On July 20, the U.S. administration announced new tariffs of 50% on certain Canadian products imported into the U.S. under Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, effective August 19. On a year-to-date basis ending June 26, 2026 had Section 338 tariffs been in place, Hammond Manufacturing Company Limited these tariffs would have impacted approximately 3.5% of net sales and reduced net income for the period by approximately 60 basis points.

Headwater Exploration Inc (T.HWX) Hit a 52-Week High of $14.36. Headwater reported second-quarter revenue of $227 million, compared to $135 million in the prior-year quarter. Net income proved to be $85.4 million, compared to $38 million in the prior-year quarter.
Kelt Exploration Ltd (T.KEL) Hit a 52-Week High of $10.61. In the second quarter, Kelt reported $44.6 million, compared to $32.4 million in the prior-year quarter.

Logan Energy Corp. (V.LGN) Hit a 52-Week High of $1.13. Logan exited the second quarter with Net Debt of $139.0 million or 0.7 times its annualized Adjusted Funds Flow for the second quarter. The Company has a $250.0 million revolving credit facility and is well positioned financially to execute on its expanded 2026 capital expenditure program.

Medicure Inc. Common Stock (V.MPH) Hit a 52-Week High of $2.50. Medicure recorded total net revenue of $7.4 million during the period ended June 30, 2026 compared to $6.7 million for the period ended June 30, 2025. Net loss for the period ended June 30, 2026 was $1.4 million or $0.14 per share compared to a net loss of $786,000 or $0.08 per share for the period ended June 30, 2025.

NorthIsle Copper and Gold Inc. (V.NCX) Hit a 52-Week High of $4.50. NorthIsle announced several additions to its Board of Directors and advisory team, including Gerardo Fernandez – Director; Dr. Gillian Davidson – Strategic Advisor: Maurice Tagami – Process Design and Metallurgical Advisor
NSJ Gold Corp. (C.NSJ) Hit a 52-Week High of 50 cents. Last week, NSJ announced completion of high resolution Aeromagnetic Survey on Its Antimony 2.0 Property, New Brunswick.

Precore Gold Corp. (C.PRCG) Hit a 52-Week High of 56 cents. In mid-August, Precore announced that it intends to conduct a non-brokered private placement through the issuance of up to 30,000,000 units of the Company at a price of C$0.20 per Unit for the gross proceeds of up to C$6,000,000. Each Unit will consist of one common share in the capital of the Company and one-half of one common share purchase warrant.

Canstar Resources Inc. (V.ROX) Hit a 52-Week High of 5.5 cents. Last week, Canstar reported results from the first phase of its 2026 drill program, including the widest massive sulphide intercept in the drilling record of its Mary March Project in the Buchans district of central Newfoundland: 15.6 metres grading 2.3% copper equivalent starting at a downhole depth of 467.4 m in drill hole MM-26-42, including 9.75 m at 3.3% CuEq.

Surge Energy Inc. (T.SGY) Hit a 52-Week High of $10.98. Surge confirms that a cash dividend to be paid on September 15, in respect of August 2026 production, for the shareholders of record on August 31, 2026, will be $0.043333 per share.

title: Bravada, Covalon, Fidelity at 52-Week Highs on News
